<div class="card-body">
'''Rebel Snowspeeder''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反乱軍スノースピーダー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客のどちらかを追加で1名乗せられる。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Rebel-Snowspeeder-PSA-101658910.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ホスの反乱軍基地の技師たちは、エアスピーダーＴ－４７を改造し、氷の惑星の極寒の大気の中でも飛行できるようにした。密閉型。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rebel Snowspeeder.

'''Card text:'''
May carry one additional pilot or passenger. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

'''Lore:'''
Engineers at the Rebel base on Hoth modified the T-47 airspeeder to fly in the frigid atmosphere of the ice planet. Enclosed.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rebel Snowspeeder]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
